info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-Delete Parking Reservations Cancel-v2-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the cancellation of parking reservations, ensuring users can manage their bookings effectively. It allows clients to send requests to revoke a reservation, thus freeing up the space for other users. Typical consumers include parking service providers and customers who need flexibility in their parking arrangements. This operation enhances user experience by providing a simple method to handle reservation changes and cancellations.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to cancel an existing reservation. Providing the correct reservation ID is necessary to successfully cancel the reservation.

requestBody.description: Request body for cancelling a reservation. This should include necessary details to identify the reservation to be cancelled.

DeleteParkingReservationsCancelRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the DELETE operation to cancel a reservation. The body must be a string indicating the reason or any additional information relevant to the cancellation.

DeleteParkingReservationsCancelResponse_.title: Cancel Reservation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the reservation.

resultId.description: A unique identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: The current state of the reservation after the cancellation operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the cancellation request, in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional details about the cancellation operation.

DeleteParkingReservationsCancelResponse_.description: Response schema for the successful cancellation of a reservation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the cancellation record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the cancellation record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation operation was automated.

AuditInfo.description: Detailed information about the audit process related to the cancellation operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
